name: app-monochrome-wallet-screen-held-in-dark-hand
title: Monochrome Wallet in a Dark Hand
whatItIs: A cover image of a hand emerging from black at the top holding a phone showing a black-and-white wallet screen with a big balance and a transaction list in mono type.
whatItMeans: Stark black and white with monospace text feels precise, technical and trustworthy. The hand adds human scale.
techniques: Dark silhouetted hand against a light backdrop
Monospace numerals and labels for a ledger feel
Two-button segmented control as the only interaction
Black card as the visual focal point

vocabulary.definition: Type and rules that resemble an accounting record.
A hand rendered in near-black to frame the device.
A joined pair of buttons where one is selected.
